nodes.label: R-ChFSI algorithm decision
nodes.rationale: Standard ChFSI with Woodbury S^-1 (1.4% error) stagnates because error applied to O(1) eigenvectors every step. R-ChFSI filters residual R=HX-SXL; as SCF converges, ||R||->0 so S^-1 error vanishes.

nodes.label: Unconstrained DIIS mixing in reciprocal space
nodes.rationale: Source-audited from CASTEP dm.f90:895-1093. CASTEP uses unconstrained DIIS (dgesv, no Lagrange multiplier), residual R=n_out-n_in, history stores deltas Dn_in and DR, mixing in reciprocal space with PW coefficients.
nodes.norm_label: unconstrained diis mixing in reciprocal space

nodes.label: Energy-window convergence check
nodes.rationale: Matching CASTEP electronic_store_energy (electronic.f90:7536-7644). Cyclic buffer of 3 energies, mixed-status tracking, max-min <= elec_energy_tol*num_ions.

nodes.label: QSfCache GPU augmentation cache
nodes.rationale: GPU-resident cache of Q^I_nm(G)*exp(-iG*R_I). Geometry-static: built once at SCF init. Species-shared storage to fit VRAM (~1.2 GB for Cu), structure factor applied per-iteration element-wise.

nodes.label: USPP density assembly (smooth rho_PW + rho_aug)
nodes.rationale: Two-channel density: construct_density_gpu produces smooth-only rho_PW, compute_aug_density_gpu adds rho_aug, build_v_eff_with_energy_impl sums before Poisson+XC. Channels have different unit conventions and geometry-staticity.

nodes.label: R-ChFSI Algorithm 3 (Das et al. 2025)
nodes.rationale: Residual-based reformulation: filter R=HX-SXL instead of X. Reference: das-2025-rchfsi/main.tex lines 586-610. As SCF converges, ||R||->0 so S^-1 approximation error vanishes.

nodes.label: SpectralBounds with lambda_min
nodes.rationale: R-ChFSI requires three distinct bounds: lambda_max, lambda_min (full spectrum), and eps_cut/lambda_T (wanted spectrum). lambda_min used in sigma=e/(lambda_min-c), currently absent from SpectralBounds.

nodes.label: cuFFT dimension ordering (ngz,ngy,ngx)
nodes.rationale: cuFFT expects dimensions in [z,y,x] order (most-significant first), matching Fortran-order index formula iz+ngz*(iy+ngy*ix). Passing [ngx,ngy,ngz] transposes FFT axes.

nodes.label: Occupation erfc sign inversion bug
nodes.rationale: Correct formula is erfc((e_b-mu)/w). Old code had erfc((mu-e_b)/w)=2-erfc((e_b-mu)/w), inverting occupation. States far below mu should be fully occupied (erfc(-large)=2).

nodes.label: Grid-stride loop accumulate_density kernel
nodes.rationale: Old kernel used blockIdx.x as grid-point index with ceil(grid_size/1024) blocks. For grid_size > 1024, points beyond 1024 silently dropped. Rewritten to grid-stride loop.

nodes.label: Recpot vs USP pseudopotential loading bug
nodes.rationale: PseudopotentialSet::from_dir picks first alphabetical match. Cu_00_OP.recpot sorts before Cu_00.usp -> all 18 ions loaded as Recpot (no V_NL, no augmentation).
nodes.norm_label: recpot vs usp pseudopotential loading bug

nodes.label: GPU-resident beta_psi_per_ion
nodes.rationale: Replace host Vec<Vec<Complex64>> with Vec<CudaSlice<CudaComplex>>. Eliminates D2H roundtrip in rayleigh_ritz step 5b. omega^I_nm contraction runs on GPU via batched gemm.

nodes.label: Rayon parallelization of VnlBatchData::precompute
nodes.rationale: Per-species precompute_q_on_grid radial Bessel transforms (1.6 KB/task) and per-ion compute_beta_g G-vector projections (288 bytes/task). NOT parallelizing fine-grid FFT loops (28 MB/task).

nodes.label: spin_deg factor in rho_aug accumulation
nodes.rationale: spin_deg=2.0 incorrectly applied. Our compute_occupations returns occ in [0,2] (spin-degeneracy already encoded). CASTEP ion.f90:7114 multiplies by 2.0 because CASTEP occ in [0,1] per spin channel. Double-counting doubled rho_aug.
